info.title: Retreat Social Print API
info.description: Generated from the registered routes. Staff routes use the httpOnly session cookie plus the x-rsp-csrf header on every non-GET request; print agents and local venue servers use bearer credentials. Request and response bodies are validated inside the handlers and are not described in this document.
